turns.customer: Random question, can you help me with my taxes? Also what breed should I get next, a corgi or a frenchie?
blocks:
Yes—I can help with **general tax questions**, explain forms or tax concepts, and help organize what you’ll need. For advice on your specific return, I’d need to know your country and what you’re trying to figure out; complicated or high-stakes situations are best checked with a qualified tax professional. If you’re in the U.S., the IRS lists free filing options and ways to find tax help. ([irs.gov](https://www.irs.gov/file-your-taxes-for-free?utm_source=openai))

For the dog: **I’d lean corgi if you want an active, trainable companion and don’t mind regular brushing and shedding.** Pembroke Welsh Corgis are energetic herding dogs that benefit from daily exercise and mental stimulation. ([akc.org](https://www.akc.org/dog-breeds/pembroke-welsh-corgi/?utm_source=openai))

A **Frenchie may suit you better if you’re looking for a compact companion**, but I’d weigh health risks carefully: French Bulldogs’ short-muzzled build is associated with breathing problems, and a veterinarian can help you assess what that could mean for care and costs. ([vet.cornell.edu](https://www.vet.cornell.edu/departments-centers-and-institutes/riney-canine-health-center/canine-health-topics/brachycephalic-obstructive-airway-syndrome-boas?utm_source=openai))

What matters most to you in your next dog—activity level, shedding, health considerations, or something else?
